label: Specification for: MEASURE_EVENTDATE_DURATIONINSECONDS
description: INTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if dwc:eventDate is bdqval:Empty or if the value of dwc:eventDate is not a valid ISO 8601 date; otherwise RUN_HAS_RESULT with the result being the duration (sensu ISO 8601) expressed in the dwc:eventDate, in seconds.
expectedResponse: INTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if dwc:eventDate is bdqval:Empty or if the value of dwc:eventDate is not a valid ISO 8601 date; otherwise RUN_HAS_RESULT with the result being the duration (sensu ISO 8601) expressed in the dwc:eventDate, in seconds.
example1: dwc:eventDate="1880-05-08/10": Response.status=RUN_HAS_RESULT, Response.result="259200", Response.comment="dwc:eventDate duration is 3 days = 259,200 seconds"
example2: dwc:eventDate="95": Response.status=INTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET, Response.comment="dwc:eventDate does not contain a valid ISO 8601-1:2019 date"
